label: cli-mistral-vibe is the ninth entry in EXECUTOR_KINDS and accepts only model, timeoutSeconds and liveTools: no reasoningEffort, no sandboxMode, no agentPersona, because Vibe pins thinking per roster row and exposes no reasoning, sandbox or persona surface.

The kind adds a dedicated fan-out adapter buildVibeLineageCommand that runs Vibe in print mode as vibe --prompt-file <lineage>/vibe-prompt.txt --output-dir <lineage>/vibe-output --trust --model <alias> --auto-approve, with cwd at the lineage directory and VIBE_HOME at <lineage>/vibe-home.

The adapter adds a three-part preflight no earlier kind performs in this shape: a command -v vibe PATH probe, an exact version gate on 3.1.2 run inside a throwaway VIBE_HOME outside the checkout, and a roster check against VIBE_ALLOWED_MODELS.

The kind adds the fan-out first per-lineage outcome read from an executor export record: resolveVibeLineageOutcome scores vibe-output/export.json so exit 0 with exit_code 0 and outcome absent or finished is success, exit 3 with an export is partial and never success, and anything else including a clean exit with no export is failure.

The kind adds a multi-name recursion guard matching vibe, vibe-rs and vibe-app-server, plus a Vibe env allowlist that passes the VIBE_ prefix and MISTRAL_API_KEY, treats VIBE_HOME as lineage state, and denies an inherited VIBE_HOME.

The kind is fan-out only: both deep-loop YAMLs carry an if_cli_mistral_vibe branch that prints that the kind runs only as a fan-out lineage and exits 2, pointing at --count=2 or a second --executor group.

Model selection is by roster alias rather than provider model name, and the allowlist is enforced twice: VIBE_SUPPORTED_MODELS holds deepseek-flash and glm-flash, isVibeSupportedModel gates the config parser, and VIBE_ALLOWED_MODELS gates the adapter.

The kind is implemented and tested while its own spec packet still records it as unbuilt: the stress fixture exists, live-contracts.json and matrix-manifest.ts name the kind, and the three unit suites carry 34 references, yet spec.md reads Status Planned and every acceptance-criteria row reads Unmet.
